newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - RESEARCH ALERT - Australia diamond stocks 'buy'.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - RESEARCH ALERT - Australia diamond stocks 'buy'.

text.p: Brokerage Saw James Capel Ltd on Tuesday recommended investors take advantage of a change in market sentiment by investing in Australian diamond exploration and production companies.
Capel analyst David Russel said Australian diamond companies have been dissapointing in the past to investors, causing a lack of capital to the sector and hurting exploration actvities.

"However, we remain confident that the firm fundamentals in the international diamond market will lead to a balanced market by 1998, which could move into a supply deficit by 1999, Russell said in a report.
Despite better fundamentals in the diamond market, there has been little positive reaction in the ranks of the Australian Diamond sector yet, Russell said.
Russell recommended investor weightings a handful of Australian companies, including Auridiam Consolidated NL, Striker Resources NL and Moonstone Diamond Corp NL.

He said an international price increase of three percent across-the-board for diamonds was weighted to more valuable larger stones, which would favour South Arica's De Beers, whose focus is on the upper end of the market, Russell said.
However, this was not good news for Australia's Ashton Mining, due to Ashton's focus on the "lower end of the quality spectrum."
Ashton holds a 40 percent interest in Argyle Diamond Mines Ltd.
The other 60 percent is held by RTZ Corp Plc-CRA Ltd.
